description: List hand-picked catalog products with /dp/ buy links: marketplace=amazon.com → US catalog (amazon.com/dp/ASIN?tag=sw-fitness-20), amazon.se → Swedish catalog (tag sw-fitness-21). If marketplace is omitted, en-US → amazon.com, otherwise amazon.se. Filter by goal/level/budgetBand/q.

country.description: Optional ISO country code, e.g. US or SE (US → amazon.com). Used when marketplace is omitted.

locale.description: Optional end-user locale, e.g. en-US, sv-SE. Defaults from Accept-Language or the store (amazon.com → en-US, amazon.se → sv-SE).

marketplace.description: Optional. Amazon storefront domain or id, e.g. amazon.com, amazon.se, us, se. Use marketplace=amazon.com for US shoppers (hand-picked amazon.com /dp/ catalog, tag sw-fitness-20). If omitted: country, then Accept-Language (en-US → amazon.com), else amazon.se.

name: browse_catalog
